_: Reference games for training mode. Copy to games.json and fill in.
_why_not_committed: games.json is gitignored because a real pack holds a real squad: names, and shirt numbers against them. This repository's rule is invented people in anything committed (see fixtures/demo-desk.json), and a roster is exactly the data that rule exists for. Keep yours local and hand it to a spotter with the rest of the pack.

_schema.video: YouTube id. Training mode stamps events with VIDEO time, so captures from different people align exactly.
_schema.teams: Two, in the order they should appear. `side` is O or D and only sets which group a player starts in; which side is on offence follows the point.
_schema.score: The tournament's own final score, if known. Not used to fill anything in - it is checked against what the capture recorded, and a disagreement means goals were missed.
_schema.links: Where the tournament's own record lives: the roster, to settle a shirt number the footage will not show, and whatever statistics the event itself published, to compare a finished capture against. Any number of them, in the order a spotter would reach for them. Opened in a new tab - nothing is fetched and nothing is stored.
